from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GeneratedScene(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#10131F"
        self.set_camera_orientation(
            phi=68 * DEGREES,
            theta=-48 * DEGREES,
            zoom=0.82,
        )

        axes = ThreeDAxes(
            x_range=[-3.5, 3.5, 1],
            y_range=[-3.5, 3.5, 1],
            z_range=[0, 3.2, 1],
            x_length=6.2,
            y_length=6.2,
            z_length=4.8,
            axis_config={
                "stroke_color": GREY_B,
                "stroke_width": 1.2,
            },
            z_axis_config={
                "stroke_color": GREY_B,
                "stroke_width": 1.2,
            },
        )

        axis_labels = axes.get_axis_labels(
            x_label=MathTex("x", font_size=34),
            y_label=MathTex("y", font_size=34),
            z_label=MathTex("z", font_size=34),
        )

        petals = VGroup()
        colors = ["#F5A6C8", "#E879A9", "#C94F91"]
        rings = [
            (0.00, 8, 0.20, 1.20),
            (0.28, 7, 0.42, 1.45),
            (0.52, 6, 0.64, 1.68),
        ]

        for layer, (base, count, lift, peak) in enumerate(rings):
            for k in range(count):
                center_angle = (
                    2 * PI * k / count
                    + (PI / count if layer == 1 else 0)
                )

                def petal(
                    u,
                    v,
                    center_angle=center_angle,
                    base=base,
                    lift=lift,
                    peak=peak,
                ):
                    r = base + (2.15 - base) * u
                    z = lift + peak * np.sin(PI * u) - 0.32 * u
                    return np.array([
                        r * np.cos(v),
                        r * np.sin(v),
                        z,
                    ])

                petals.add(
                    Surface(
                        petal,
                        u_range=[0, 1],
                        v_range=[
                            center_angle - 0.26,
                            center_angle + 0.26,
                        ],
                        resolution=(12, 8),
                        fill_color=colors[layer],
                        fill_opacity=0.88,
                        checkerboard_colors=False,
                        stroke_color="#FFD6E8",
                        stroke_width=0.45,
                    )
                )

        center = Sphere(
            radius=0.38,
            resolution=(16, 16),
            fill_color="#FFD166",
            fill_opacity=1,
        )

        title = Text(
            "ROTATIONAL LOTUS",
            font_size=38,
            color=WHITE,
        ).to_corner(UL, buff=0.35)

        subtitle = Text(
            "layered parametric petals",
            font_size=24,
            color="#B9C2D0",
        ).next_to(
            title,
            DOWN,
            aligned_edge=LEFT,
            buff=0.12,
        )

        equation = MathTex(
            r"\mathbf{P}_k(u,v)=\big(r(u)\cos v_k,\ r(u)\sin v_k,\ z(u)\big)",
            font_size=27,
            color=WHITE,
        ).to_edge(
            RIGHT,
            buff=0.35,
        ).shift(UP * 1.55)

        radial = MathTex(
            r"r(u)=0.4+1.75u,\qquad z(u)=1.2+1.2\sin(\pi u)-0.3u",
            font_size=25,
            color="#F5A6C8",
        ).to_edge(
            RIGHT,
            buff=0.35,
        ).shift(UP * 0.55)

        rotation = MathTex(
            r"v_k=\frac{2\pi k}{N}\quad (k=0,\ldots,N-1)",
            font_size=25,
            color="#8BD3DD",
        ).to_edge(
            RIGHT,
            buff=0.35,
        ).shift(DOWN * 0.45)

        legend = Text(
            "u: center → rim     v: rotation",
            font_size=22,
            color="#B9C2D0",
        ).to_edge(
            RIGHT,
            buff=0.35,
        ).shift(DOWN * 1.35)

        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(
            title,
            subtitle,
            equation,
            radial,
            rotation,
            legend,
        )

        self.play(
            FadeIn(axes),
            FadeIn(axis_labels),
            FadeIn(title),
            FadeIn(subtitle),
            run_time=1.4,
        )

        self.play(
            LaggedStart(
                *[Create(petal_surface) for petal_surface in petals],
                lag_ratio=0.035,
            ),
            FadeIn(center),
            run_time=4.0,
        )

        self.play(
            Write(equation),
            Write(radial),
            Write(rotation),
            FadeIn(legend),
            run_time=2.2,
        )

        self.wait(1.5)

        self.move_camera(
            phi=64 * DEGREES,
            theta=-35 * DEGREES,
            run_time=1.8,
        )

        self.wait(0.8)
